rules.text: Every SDL event the game polls is passed to ImGui_ImplSDL3_ProcessEvent before the next ImGui frame starts.

probes.check: am_probe_imgui_sdl3_events(): pushes a synthetic SDL_EVENT_MOUSE_MOTION, runs one frame, and checks ImGui's io.MousePos matches it.

seeded_violation.description: Skip the ImGui_ImplSDL3_ProcessEvent call in the event loop.

probes.check: The lifecycle probe checks this recipe's shutdown ordering constraints.

seeded_violation.description: Call ImGui_ImplSDLGPU3_Shutdown before SDL_WaitForGPUIdle in am_pair_imgui_sdl3_shutdown().

adaptation_notes: am_pair_imgui_sdl3_shutdown() calls SDL_WaitForGPUIdle first: the renderer backend releases GPU resources the device may still be using.
In probe mode the setup sets io.IniFilename = nullptr so probe runs write no imgui.ini into the repository.
The SDL3 platform backend and SDL_GPU renderer backend are compiled from the same Dear ImGui commit as the core, through the port's sdl3-binding and sdlgpu3-binding features.
